PR #423 opened: https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/423

Summary of the fix:
- Confirmed the gap was real: `recordPromptCacheMetric()` (the Prompt & Cache Framework's Phase-1 call site in `chat-service.ts`) only ever wrote to the observability-only `prompt_cache_metrics` table, never to `token_usage_ledger` — the table Finance/cost-guard actually reads.
- Added `estimateCacheSavingsUsd()` in `llm-client.ts` (Anthropic's 90% cache-read discount), a new `cache_savings_usd` column on `token_usage_ledger` (migration 0225), and wired `recordPromptCacheMetric()` to also log into the ledger via `logTokenUsage()`, with the savings total surfaced in `getTokenUsageSummary()`.
- Full suite (1328 tests), typecheck, lint, build, and the guardrail-presence check all pass.
- Noted in PROGRESS.md an out-of-scope observation found along the way: `token_usage_ledger` had zero `product_orchestra` rows anywhere before this change, so cost-guard's cap enforcement was silently a no-op — left that broader gap untouched since it wasn't part of this finding.
